messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx (502/504) and timeout rates observed from streaming-gateway (us-west-2) starting at 01:05 UTC. Affected route: /v1/streams. Error spike correlates with increased chunked encoding errors and client-side cancels. Auto-paging flagged high retry rates.

maya (oncall): I'm looking. traffic + latency graphs show a sharp tail starting ~01:04, p50 fine, p95/p99 and errors up. Any rolling deploys?

jon (sre): No deploys on infra side in last hour. Seeing many upstream 504s from model-proxy: connection reset / upstream prematurely closed. Could be chunked encoding handling at nginx/proxy.

emily (runtime): Runtime reports KV cache pressure and some long-tail GPU GC spikes around same window. But the trace shows proxy-level resets before model runtime times out.

carl (support): Getting tickets: "stream disconnects mid-response" from 3 customers in us-west. One on websocket client, two on streaming via SSE. Marking as P1 for customer-impact.

maya (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) briefly route streaming traffic to fallback model-variant (non-batched smaller model) 2) enable non-streaming fallback for heavy clients 3) increase proxy idle timeouts and disable chunked flush coalescing. Anyone object?

jon (sre): Agree. I'll flip routing rule to prefer fallback-variant for 5m and enable 504->retry backoff for clients. Doing step 1 now.

infra-bot: routing-change: stream-route-switch applied by jon at 01:12 UTC (rule id r-893).

jon (sre): Done. Redirected ~18% of traffic; error rate dropped to ~9% from 22% within 40s.

emily (runtime): Adding: a temporary change to model-proxy keepalive settings may help. Current upstream_timeout=30s. Suggest bump to 60s while we investigate chunked encoding.

maya (oncall): I'll update nginx/proxy timeouts. jon, can you enable logs at debug for model-proxy chunked handling? Need examples of the "upstream prematurely closed" stack.

jon (sre): Enabling debug logs now. Also capturing a few failed request traces and raw TCP dumps (PCAP) for 01:04-01:14 window.

emily (runtime): From runtime side: when client cancels (client-side stream cancel) we were doing a fast KV cache release which raced with the chunk flush. Adding a small 200ms flush delay might avoid mid-chunk closes. Patching a toggle now (safe-hotfix).

maya (oncall): Support message to customers: "We're routing streaming requests to a fallback variant and working on a fix for disconnects. If you need immediate reliability, enable non-streaming mode in your client temporarily." Carl, can you post that to affected customers?

carl (support): Posted to the three customers. One replied that non-streaming is acceptable as a temporary workaround.

jon (sre): Debug logs show pattern: proxy sends last-chunk, waits for downstream ACK, upstream closes connection before chunk terminator in some cases. Suspect chunked-encoding flush ordering bug in model-proxy 2.1.7.

emily (runtime): Confirmed: we reproduced locally with a simulated slow consumer. Model-proxy truncated response when upstream send buffer was cleared during async flush. I have a patch to ensure final chunk is written atomically. Rolling to canary 2 nodes.

infra-bot: canary-deploy: model-proxy 2.1.8-canary rolled to canary pool at 01:28 UTC. Health checks passing.

jon (sre): After canary, error rate on canary nodes is ~0.3% vs 9% baseline. Rolling patch to remaining pool now with 5 node batch.

maya (oncall): I've left routing to fallback until 01:35 to avoid cascading failures during rollout. Once patch is on all nodes, we'll switch back.

jon (sre): Patch rolled to 100% by 01:34. Switching stream-route back to normal.

infra-bot: routing-change: stream-route-switch reverted by jon at 01:35 UTC.

jon (sre): Post-rollback metrics: errors down to 0.6% p10m, streaming disconnects near zero. Latencies normalized.

maya (oncall): Customer impact summary for incident timeline: 01:04-01:28 partial degradation with 15-25% elevated 5xx and client disconnects; 01:28-01:34 routing to fallback reduced impact; 01:34+ full mitigation. Affected customers: 3 reported, several others via telemetry.

carl (support): Logged follow-up with customers: offering 1:1 sync and credits for impacted windows. Product asked for a short summary.

sarah (product): Thanks — can we get short root cause and next actions for customers: 1) root cause: model-proxy chunked encoding race causing premature upstream close 2) fix: patch in 2.1.8 to make final-chunk atomic 3) infra changes: increased proxy timeouts and improved streaming canary process 4) follow-ups: postmortem and retro.

maya (oncall): I'll own the postmortem and retro. Action items: - emily: push permanent patch and add unit test for chunked flush atomicity - jon: add NGINX/proxy config defaults and alert thresholds for chunked errors - support/product: customer outreach + credits - infra: add graceful drain tests to canary pipeline

emily (runtime): Will add tests and a regression suite. PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/model-proxy/pull/452

jon (sre): I'll add alert rule for streaming 5xx rate + new Synthetic streaming test.

maya (oncall): Closing oncall. Leaving handoff note: if errors creep back, escalate to emily + jon. Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.

carl (support): :thumbsup: closing tickets with note and will reopen if they report further issues.

incident-bot: incident-closed: severity reduced to SEV2 at 01:42 UTC. Postmortem link (draft): https://go/reports/incident-1799954321-streaming-gateway-timeouts
